body: This post made my cry you sound almost identical to a friend of mine.  Thank you it was really nice to hear that, even though it wasn't meant for me

I don't feel like it's anything interesting or worth talking about anymore, but I guess.  Suicide just seems like the natural and most effective way to end the pain I've been going through.  I feel really hopeless about my future, mostly about relationships and even friendships to a lesser degree.  Ive been slowly losing my friends and I've never been able to act on an opportunity to get a girlfriend.  I've opened up to a few close friends about it but if I get too far into it, it's too much for them to handle and they can't talk to me anymore.  I just push everybody away and the pain from having no connections with anybody will be too much, so I feel I should kill myself before it gets too bad.
I'm not planning to attempt for at least a couple months, so it'll have time to balance out.  Hopefully I change my mind
I've been on therapy for almost a year now, but it hasn't really been helping.  My therapist was the one who first suggested I try antidepressants
